plugin_fixtures.generator: a cut of the bundled file to the corpus's keys
plugin_fixtures.cut: the header and the rows of the bundled `LoFtool_scores.txt` (Ensembl VEP_plugins, Apache License 2.0) whose gene symbol a transcript of the pruned cache carries, bytes kept (CRLF line ends included), the symbol SOD1 respelled `sod1` so the file itself exercises the case-insensitive match of both engines; the manifest's run reads the whole bundled file beside Ensembl VEP's module through `--dir_plugins {plugins}` and vep-rs reads this cut through the same flag, so the two runs write the same rows

vep_command: vep -i variants.vcf -o <out> --offline --cache --dir_cache <cache> --cache_version 116 --species homo_sapiens --assembly GRCh38 --format vcf --buffer_size 5000 --fork 1 --stats_text --quiet --force_overwrite --dir_plugins {plugins} --plugin LoFtool [--tab|--vcf|--json]
input: 29 ClinVar GRCh38 records on chromosome 21 (public ClinVar identifiers; INFO dropped), the records of tests/golden/116/GRCh38-plugin-pli, one or two in the canonical transcript of each chosen gene (an exonic substitution and, where the records offer one, an exonic indel): TPTE, LIPI, APP, SOD1, TTC3, DYRK1A, DSCAM, RUNX1, KCNJ6, SETD4, CXADR and HUNK, which the LoFtool file lists; GABPA, LTN1, TMPRSS15 and two further genes, which it does not list; and one intergenic record more than 5,000 bases from any transcript. The scores reach the output in every shape the plugin prints: LoFtool's `%g` from `0.00427` to `0.992`.
generator: manifest: scripts/golden/build_golden_corpus.py select --release 116 --assembly GRCh38 --suite plugin-loftool=<reference over the candidate records>=candidates.vcf --k 3 --seed 1 --include <each record's name> --covers LoFtool --matrix tests/parity/matrix.tsv --flag=--dir_plugins --flag={plugins} --flag=--plugin --flag=LoFtool, then flag-set for each flag_sets entry and classify for the manifest's run and each flag set; json_cache: scripts/golden/prune_json_cache.py --gzip --drop sorted_exons --drop protein_features --drop protein_function_predictions --perl-info <cache>/info.txt --cache-version 116 over the chromosome 21 slice of the vep-rs JSON conversion of the Ensembl VEP 116 GRCh38 cache; plugin_data: the cut described under plugin_fixtures; expected outputs: scripts/concordance/generate_reference_output.sh --corpus --dir-plugins <VEP_plugins checkout> for the manifest's run and, per flag set, for a copy of the corpus carrying the set's flags as its own, whose outputs and record are the set's
